**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, confidence 0.86)**

**Issue.** While § 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment, § 2.2 does exactly the opposite: it makes Vendor our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term." That is an exclusivity/field-of-use restriction binding us on what we may buy or build, and it also contradicts § 2.1 (no minimum or purchase commitment).

**Sweep for other restrictions.** Searches for "compet", "exclusive", and "shall not develop" surfaced nothing else binding Customer. § 24.2 (Vendor may not assign to a Customer competitor) binds Vendor and benefits us — not flagged.

**Redline (validated, ok:true).** § 2.2 replaced with a non-exclusive appointment plus express confirmation that nothing restricts Customer's business, products, or fields of use — the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position and resolves the internal conflict. The comment offers the narrowed fallback (named product, term only, ≤12 months, carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions) if Vendor pushes back.
